Sizes assume the fork is about 2 m from the camera; the leaders end where the photo or the prediction ends. Seen from the front, the model looks like the photo.
The branches bend out of the tree's plane where the summer depth sees the wood. Pale sections: their depth was not seen (leaves in front), so they follow the prior (the plane) and their bend is uncertain. "Exaggerate bends" stretches every bend for display only; the numbers and the .ply files are at true scale.
